influence_form_implemented.direct: <grad_W l_p, DW_e>_F via the exact rank-one shortcut r_e^T (grad_W l_p) k_e / (k_e.k_e); grad_W l_p is the FULL weight gradient (no A2 assumption); l_p = raw target_true logit at the prompt's last token.
influence_form_implemented.factorized: Eq.3 alpha(e,p)*S_e*C_ep, alpha=cos(g_p,r_e)*||g_p||, g_p=grad_{r_p} l_p at r_p=W k_p (probe's own subject-token position) -- the A2-approximate form. ||k_p|| dropped (within-probe-column constant; cancels in Spearman rank).

alpha_A4_test.note: A4' requires HIGH sign-consistency AND LOW CV per probe (section 2, docs/findings/THEOREM-SXC-DRAFT-2026-07-06.md). sign_consistency_rate 1.0 = alpha never changes sign for that probe across edits.
